## Build Failure Analysis

**Solution:** `BuildDiag.sln` (3 projects: `Core`, `Services`, `Api`)

### Root Cause (1 issue)

**`Services.csproj`** — Missing NuGet package reference to `Newtonsoft.Json`

`UserService.cs` uses `Newtonsoft.Json` and `Newtonsoft.Json.Linq` (specifically `JObject`), but `Services.csproj` has no `<PackageReference>` for it.

| Error | Location | Message |
|-------|----------|---------|
| CS0246 | UserService.cs(2,7) | `Newtonsoft` namespace not found |
| CS0246 | UserService.cs(3,7) | `Newtonsoft` namespace not found |
| CS0246 | UserService.cs(22,19) | `JObject` type not found |

### Cascading Failure

**`Api.csproj`** never compiled (`Csc` task was skipped) because it depends on `Services.csproj` via `<ProjectReference>`. This is **not** an independent error — it will resolve once `Services` builds.

### Fix

Add the missing package reference to `Services/Services.csproj`:

```xml
<ItemGroup>
  <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" />
</ItemGroup>
```
